update_policies.docs_update_policy: Human-readable docs may be updated when consistent with project_truth and pipeline_contract.
update_policies.clean_rerun_policy: Ordinary tasks must not write into clean_rerun.
update_policies.manifest_bloat_policy: Ordinary tasks should not create new long-term manifest files unless explicitly authorized; update the existing appropriate manifest instead.
update_policies.stable_contract_policy: Project truth and pipeline contract manifests are stable/read-only unless an authorized task changes project truth.
update_policies.frequently_updated_policy: validated_milestones_manifest_v0_1.json may be updated frequently by validation tasks.
update_policies.temporary_planning_policy: Temporary planning manifests should be merged, archived, or deleted when their purpose is complete and their retention preconditions are satisfied.
update_policies.retention_plan_policy: Use manifest_retention_plan_v0_1.json for deletion/merge preconditions before pruning docs or manifests.
